Definition and scope: Dated NZD reference rate by tenor for the instrument named on the curve
Illustrative treatment: Invented 2.50% policy-rate proxy plus a pre-declared term slope at 3/6/12/24/36/60 months
Data required for calibration: Dated observed swap or bank-bill quotes with source, instrument, as-of time and conventions
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Steeper (x2) and inverted (x-1) slope at fixed offers and after reoptimisation
Known uncertainty: No observed quote used. Linear interpolation of simple rates is a convention

Definition and scope: Marginal term funding premium over the reference for the bank's own issuance
Illustrative treatment: Invented premiums rising from 0.60% at 3 months to 1.70% at 60 months
Data required for calibration: Marginal issuance spreads by tenor, liquidity buffer costs and their allocation basis
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Premium x1.5 and x0.5 at fixed offers and after reoptimisation
Known uncertainty: Marginal versus average basis not decided

Definition and scope: Repricing tenor for the reference component and liquidity buckets for remaining life
Illustrative treatment: 12-month repricing; liquidity weights 25% at 12m, 35% at 36m, 40% at 60m
Data required for calibration: Amortisation, prepayment, refinancing and rollover behaviour by fixed term and vintage
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Repricing 24m and all liquidity at 60m: attribution moves, consolidated objective unchanged
Known uncertainty: Bucket weights are invented, not a behavioural life

Definition and scope: Contractual maturity credit with no rollover beyond maturity
Data required for calibration: Observed rollover and early redemption by term, tier and channel
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Phase 4c supply term must equal the FTP deposit tenor (mismatch rejected)

Definition and scope: Tenor at which the aggregate residual deficit is funded externally, and surplus reinvestment basis
Illustrative treatment: Deficit at 12-month all-in rate; surplus at 3-month reference plus zero spread
Data required for calibration: Funding plan by tenor, hedging basis and reinvestment policy
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Wholesale tenor 36m; surplus fixed offer at 7.50% / 4.50%
Known uncertainty: One external rate prices the whole deficit; no bucketed funding or hedge P&L

Definition and scope: Pre-steering, pre-tax, pre-opex return on required capital, reporting only
Illustrative treatment: Adds back shortfall and concentration steering penalties; capital = loans x RWA weight x 10%
Data required for calibration: Profit bridge, tax and opex basis, capital definition compatible with Phase 4e
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Model versus economic ROE in every comparison row; ROE floor unchanged
